curated.tagline: Umbrella catalog + subtree publisher for 11 bar plugins
curated.description: Authoring catalog and publish pipeline for the Omarchy plugin estate — hardware (fan, power), markets (ticker), AI-agent surfaces (agents, numbat, bumblebee, neo, pplx, wisp shell), and overlays (standby, nexus, connections). Each plugin subtree-publishes to its own repo for `omarchy plugin add`; most are listed on the official marketplace.
highlights: Toast correctness layer: severity gates, cooldowns, burst coalescing, DND
275-test suite covering helpers and manifest schema
curated.architecture: Umbrella catalog → per-plugin subtrees → `omarchy plugin add` repos → marketplace listings
